proven_application_failure: Only collect_submissions was inside the per-company exception boundary. 8-K body and Form 4 network/parser failures escaped and stopped the whole job. No durable company checkpoint meant the next run restarted the universe.
transport_cause: Historical job error_summary discarded the original transport exception type and endpoint. It cannot establish whether the interruption was ReadTimeout, ConnectTimeout or a server disconnect. New code preserves endpoint, status, error code and exception-type chain in the company cursor. No evidence of HTTP 429/403 or SEC rate rejection was observed.
fixes: Keep the one process-wide SEC budget of 5 requests per second, including retries.
Record completed and failed companies in existing ingest.source_cursors; unfinished cycles survive restarts and date rollover.
Isolate body/Form 4 source or parse failures per company; permission/database errors propagate.
Use original per-filing info/Form4 identities to avoid duplicate writes when retrying an issuer.

full_real_run.reason: The current time is outside the authorized SEC slot. Endpoint diagnostics are not counted as a complete production collection.
full_real_run.guard: Use actual SystemClock and Runtime window; check native scheduler job has ended before a branch validation run. No production service restart or timer change.
